data.narrative:
Pragmatic Semiconductor is a Series D-stage chip design company in the Chips & Semiconductors sector with $231M total raised to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 8 private peers at comparable or adjacent stages (Tenstorrent, Nearfield Instruments, Cerebras, Credo, SambaNova, Etched, Ayar Labs, DEEPX) and 3 public semiconductor comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two valuation methods triangulate to a defensible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement to the $231M raised proxy, implying $346M. Peer-median anchoring across the five most directly comparable private companies—ranging from $529M (DEEPX, Series C) to $5.0B (Etched, Series E)—yields a median of $2.7B. The public-comp method (3-ticker P/S median of 18.9x) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, standard for private companies. 

The two applicable methods generate a triangulated valuation range of $295M (low) to $3.1B (high), with a median of $1.5B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Pragmatic's product maturity, customer concentration, and path to commercialization relative to peer positioning. Investors should treat the low end as a floor proxying early-stage risk and the high end as consistent with late-stage peers; narrowing this range requires proprietary operating data.
